chunks: Abu Zakariyya narrated from Abu Basir, who said: Abu Abdullah عليه السلام said:
When a child from the children of the believers dies, a caller announces in the kingdom of the heavens and the earth: Indeed, so-and-so, the son of so-and-so, has died.
If his parents, one of them, or some of his household from among the believers had died, he is entrusted to them so that they may nourish him.
Otherwise, he is entrusted to Fatimah عليها السلام, and she nourishes him until his parents, one of them, or some of his household arrive, then she hands him over to them.

key_terms.تَغْذُوهُ: she nourishes and cares for him
key_terms.فَاطِمَةَ عَلَيْهَا السَّلَامُ: Lady Fatimah, peace be upon her, who is entrusted with the child's care
key_terms.مَلَكُوتِ: the dominion or unseen kingdom of divine reality

ai.seo_question: What happens to the children of believers who die before their parents according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the condition of believing children who die, portraying their care in the unseen realm after death. If believing relatives have preceded them, they are entrusted to them; otherwise, they are entrusted to Fatimah عليها السلام until their family arrives. The report highlights divine mercy, the dignity of believing children, and the special station of Fatimah عليها السلام.
